title: Feature: API product breakout — surface subproducts (Twilio Messaging/Voice/Video, Azure services, GitHub GHES) as a distinct dimension above versions

done: src/core/domain/discovery-types.ts — DiscoveredVersion has {label,version,url,format}. No product dimension.
src/adapters/secondary/github-discovery-adapter.ts — returns flat DiscoveredVersion[] from repo scan
src/components/sidebar/VersionPicker.jsx — flat dropdown/list of all versions
src/components/sidebar/IntegrationList.jsx — now grouped by ApiCategory (this PR's quick win)
prior_work.motivation: Providers like Twilio ship ~15 subproducts (Messaging/Voice/Video/Studio/Verify/TaskRouter/Flex/Conversations/Lookups/Pricing/Numbers/Events/Serverless/Monitor/Routes) in one repo. Azure ships hundreds of services (Compute, Storage, Network, ...). GitHub ships api.github.com, ghes-3.11, ghes-3.12, ghec. Flattening these into a single version dropdown is unusable at scale — users cannot find the API they want, and version comparison becomes meaningless across subproducts.

steps.description: Extend domain types: add optional ApiProduct dimension to DiscoveredVersion. Shape: { readonly product?: { key: string; name: string } }. Also add helper to extract product from spec URL/filename (Twilio: regex /spec\/json\/twilio_([^_]+)_v\d+/, GitHub: regex /api\.github\.com|ghes-(\d+\.\d+)|ghec/, Azure: the service name from azure-rest-api-specs/specification/<service>/, fallback: parse info.title). Pure domain — zero external deps, no imports outside domain/.
steps.done_condition: src/core/domain/discovery-types.ts has ApiProduct type; src/core/domain/product-extractor.ts has extractProduct(url, title, providerSlug) returning ApiProduct|undefined; unit tests pass for Twilio/GitHub/Azure/fallback patterns

steps.description: Update github-discovery-adapter and apisguru-discovery-adapter to call product-extractor for each discovered spec and populate the new product field. Do NOT filter/deduplicate — just annotate. Existing consumers that ignore the field continue to work (backwards compatible).
steps.done_condition: discovery results for Twilio include product for every version; running discovery-demo.ts prints grouped subproducts

steps.description: Group versions by product in VersionPicker.jsx. UI: two-tier selector — product (sorted alphabetically, with count badge) → versions within that product. When a provider has only one product (Stripe, OpenAI), skip the product level entirely and render flat. Preserve existing v1/v2 pair-selection behavior within a single product (cross-product diffing is meaningless).
steps.done_condition: Twilio shows 15 product groups; Stripe still shows flat version list; selecting two versions from the same product enables Compare; picking versions from different products shows a disabled Compare with a 'pick two versions of the same product' hint

steps.description: Persist last-selected product per provider in localStorage (key 'apidiff:lastProduct:<slug>'). On provider switch, restore the previously selected product. This matters because Twilio users typically work in one product (Messaging) at a time and shouldn't re-pick it every session.
steps.done_condition: selecting a product persists across page reload; switching providers restores each provider's last product independently
